rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with ~condition, control as reference, a justified >=10-in->=3-samples filter, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage (ashr fallback), and an explicit statement that n=3 is underpowered. QC covers library sizes, VST PCA, distance heatmap and a stated no-drop outlier policy. Enrichment correctly notes the absence of zebrafish curated collections, uses native org.Dr.eg.db GO (version named) with the tested-gene universe, stated ranking metric, size windows and a thin-coverage caveat, and explicitly forbids symbol-case projection onto human sets; it loses points for not naming the Ensembl release, for not committing to one-to-one orthologs in the optional cross-species layer, and for a somewhat loose padj<0.10 fallback for ORA.
